register_aiteammate_refusal: `register --aiteammate` is unsupported. Register only runs `a365 setup blueprint` plus MCP/Bot permission setup; the AI Teammate agentic user is created/activated after `publish --aiteammate` via M365 Admin Centre upload and per-user activation.
security_support_after_v1: After v1.0, security fixes are provided for the latest 1.x minor release only. Earlier 1.x minors and all 0.x releases are unsupported.
sidecar_migration_policy: Within 1.x, Hermes-A365 reads every Hermes-owned sidecar written by any 1.x release and every 0.9.x shape listed in SURFACE. Additive stamps run on the owning writer, once, under an exclusive lock, and are idempotent. The original bytes are copied to a sibling `*.backup-<UTC-timestamp>.json` mode `0600` before the first rewrite. A second run against an already-current file does not write another backup. Identity-binding changes stay explicit: bot-service v1→v2 still requires `--confirm-legacy-binding` equal to `--agent-name` and `--confirm-bot-target` equal to the ARM id; publish v1→v2 still requires `--app-version` strictly above the Admin Center version. A `schemaVersion` newer than this build is an error. The file is left untouched. 1.x does not claim to read 2.x sidecars. Downgrade is restore-the-backup, not an automatic rewrite to 0.9.x.
